subject: INVOKE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB757.md landed w46i2. An OMITTED argument (both 14.9.23.2 spellings, and the 8.4.3.4.2 inline form) against a formal whose header lacks the OPTIONAL phrase is COBOL2237 at bind for a typed receiver (negative); through a universal receiver the formal is known only at runtime, so the callee's __CobolInvoke switch admits the OMITTED descriptor only against an OPTIONAL formal (9.3.6 match rule 3 b) and otherwise stops before the method runs (14.9.23.4 GR7c). Against an OPTIONAL formal both spellings compile and run (golden).
